items.title: Create a Token Pass key named lab-worker in the Vercel dashboard (Token Pass tab), then rotate the exposed key
items.why: A Token Pass key can only be created in the dashboard. The old key was pasted in chat and sits in plaintext in the opencode config.

items.title: ZDR classes: stay strict (no free fallback) or allow free fallbacks
items.why: Strict is the safe default and the current code. EXP-005 measures what strictness costs before you loosen it.

items.title: Approve a Railway infra cap of $20 per month for the lab
items.why: Proposal, not a quote. Railway pricing and sleep behaviour are unverified until EXP-004 measures them.

items.title: Say what 'software factory' refers to
items.why: The term was not found in the repos. EXP-007 is parked until it is defined.

items.title: Delete the $1-budget gateway keys after a week of zero spend
items.why: Housekeeping. Fewer keys means fewer leak paths.

items.title: Routing brain hardening: Codex round 1 asked for changes, fixes in progress, then re-review, registry preflight, merge
items.why: Receipts and budget enforcement that every experiment depends on.

items.title: Curate suite starlight-core-v0: 12 replayable tasks from closed estate PRs
items.why: A comparison needs the same tasks with a test that decides pass or fail.

items.title: Worker Phase 0: container, entrypoint, per-key budget, receipts out
items.why: Isolated place to run harnesses we do not want installed on the YELLOW-zone laptop.

items.title: Ruled 2026-10-21: SIS run-receipt v1 is the envelope; routing detail travels in stage notes and hash-bound evidence
items.why: Frank approved SIS run-receipt v1 as the envelope. v1 forbids extra properties, so there is no extension block; see ops/plans/2026-10-21-receipt-schema-decision.md.

items.title: Rule on the open-core boundary, licence and trademark for the receipts product
items.why: No ruling found in the estate. Recommendation: open spec, verifier, free profile; closed hosted ledger and aggregate data. See the product plan section 7.

items.title: Build the harness-neutral runner: replay a task at its parent commit, run any harness headless, run the checker, write a receipt with experiment and harness fields
items.why: The current battery calls the gateway directly, so it ranks models, not harnesses. Needs PR 377's receipt API.

items.title: Author the web-v0 and content-v0 packs: briefs, fixtures and mechanical checkers (axe, Playwright, link and constraint scripts)
items.why: EXP-008 and EXP-009 need website and content tasks with checkers written before any run. Checker tools are not yet confirmed in the worker image.

items.title: Draft the three playbooks (build-a-website, build-a-product, run-an-experiment) as skills with saved evals
items.why: A skill without a saved eval stays out of the default prompt. EXP-009 needs the drafts to test.

items.title: Add harness, experiment, task id and token counts to the routing receipt so the bridge can build a full v1 receipt
items.why: The routing record has no harness, experiment, task id or tokens today. Lands in a PR after PR 377 merges.

items.title: Ship a standalone verify command: signature, recomputed totals, maker not equal to checker, planted-fault fixtures
items.why: No public verifier reads the run-receipt predicate yet (SIS docs/receipts.md). The product's trust claim depends on one.
